title: An Act to Allow Residential Housing on Church Property Located in Commercial Zones

summary.text:
This bill is a concept draft pursuant to Joint Rule 208.

This bill proposes to allow residential housing on church property located in commercial zones.

status_label: Ought Not to Pass Pursuant To Joint Rule 310

final_disposition.label: Ought Not to Pass Pursuant To Joint Rule 310

chamber_actions.action: Received by the Clerk of the House on January 30, 2025.
The Bill was REFERRED to the Committee on HOUSING AND ECONOMIC DEVELOPMENT pursuant to Joint Rule 308.2 and ordered printed pursuant to Joint Rule 401.
Carried over, in the same posture, to the next special or regular session of the 132nd Legislature, pursuant to Joint Order SP 519.
